ownership.quote: Remote Shell Access in the Browser. Founded in by David Fiala, Teclada has employees based in San Francisco.

stage.note: Only a confirmed Y Combinator W23 accelerator investment was found; no press release, Crunchbase entry, or other source discloses a priced seed/Series A round, so stage is inferred as pre-seed from the YC investment alone.

note: YC directory confirms Teclada (batch W23, status Active, founder David Fiala, San Francisco) shares the domain teclada.com with the pricing card. Product is browser-based SSH / privileged remote access for servers and workstations (not a compute sandbox provider). No funding round amounts, investor names beyond YC, or revenue figures were found; company appears independent and still operating per its live pricing page (2024 copyright).
